Questions

Before you book a call

Straight answers to what businesses ask us first. Anything else, write to info@dakyx.com.

Do I need an internal development team?

No. We can serve as your external technology partner for the specific systems and responsibilities agreed in your plan or contract.

Can I cancel?

Yes. There is no fixed three-month minimum. Final billing and how work in progress is valued are set out in your service agreement, and anything owed for a month you have paid for is still delivered.

What if I need more than my plan includes?

You can approve additional scoped work, move to a higher plan or schedule the work for a future month. Nothing extra is charged or started without your approval.

Do unused allowances carry over?

No. Monthly allowances expire at the end of each service month.

Who owns what you build?

Paid-for custom deliverables are yours, subject to any clearly disclosed third-party licences and pre-existing components. Your hosting, domains and provider accounts are in your name by default.

Are hosting and AI costs included?

Yes, up to the hosting, software and usage allowance of your plan. Anything above that is agreed with you before it is spent.

Which currency do you bill in?

Clients billed in Ghana pay in cedis (GHS). International clients are billed in US dollars; ask us for a USD quote.

Do you provide IT helpdesk and hardware repair?

No. We focus on the agreed websites, software, automation, integrations and AI work. We do not repair devices, install networks or provide managed cybersecurity.
